note: Independent audit against RFC 7611 Section 3 (post-LOCAL_PREF ACCEPT_OWN preference step MUST only be invoked for RFC 4364 VPN-IP routes, never for imported IP routes in a VRF). Source review confirms extractCandidate is the sole production Candidate constructor, isVPNIPFamily strictly gates on SAFI 128 (SAFIVPN) with AFI IPv4 or IPv6 only, and compareAcceptOwn sits immediately after Step 1 LOCAL_PREF and before compareAIGP/Step 2 AS_PATH across compareBeforeMED, comparePairWithReason, and multipathEqual. TestRFC7611DecisionStepOnlyForVPNIPRoutes covers both polarities with bgp/accept-own enabled: positive tests both ipv4/vpn and ipv6/vpn, proving an ACCEPT_OWN route with tied LOCAL_PREF beats a shorter-AS_PATH candidate in SelectBest, explains as BestStepAcceptOwn in SelectBestExplain, excludes the non-ACCEPT_OWN sibling in SelectMultipath, and still loses to a higher LOCAL_PREF=200 non-ACCEPT_OWN candidate (confirming placement after LOCAL_PREF); negative tests ipv4/unicast, ipv6/unicast (representing imported IP routes in a VRF), and l2vpn/evpn with ACCEPT_OWN directly in RIB storage, proving the step is not invoked (shorter AS_PATH wins in SelectBest and SelectBestExplain as BestStepASPathLen, and equal-attribute paths remain multipath siblings). Both discrimination records in rfc/discrimination/rfc7611/RFC7611-3-1.json are body-panic reverts on compareAcceptOwn (proving producer reachability, not normal-return semantic mutation); semantic enforcement is established by source review.
